prerequisites: Fundamentals of systems and control theory

learning_outcomes.text: The student must be able to use the basic methodologies of Automatic Control in specific applications, through the development of a simple project, assisted by the teacher.

Develop in the student the ability to personally re-elaborate the analysis and synthesis knowledge learned during the Degree Course, by tackling a practical design problem, stimulating autonomous work skills.
Complements of Automatic Control methodologies specific to the developed project; additional knowledge in an Engineering sector, topic of the project.
Being able to independently tackle an analysis and synthesis project in an Automatic Control problem.
Being able to evaluate different methodological opportunities for a specific application and choose, with engineering criteria, the most suitable solutions, providing appropriate justifications.
Being able to publicly illustrate design choices and application results, both with technical language and in a way understandable to potential customers.

Learning abilities are stimulated by the need to acquire specific knowledge on a particular synthesis problem in an application sector and by the importance of deepening sector methodologies, abilities which are then part of the final evaluation process.
Students will be able to take care of every aspect of the design and implementation of an automatic control system prototype for a system of their interest.

Specifically, they will be able to design the entire control loop for a mechatronic system, including the choice of its hardware and software components independently and based on the evaluation of system requirements, as well as communicate and present their design choices.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to design and prototyping methods (week 1)
assessment_rules: To be eligible, students must demonstrate sufficient knowledge of topics related to control loop design, including aspects of sizing and selection of its elements. They must also be able to complete the development of a control system for a real application autonomously, presenting the results logically and coherently.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
